Hello 👋 my name is M.K. Muere - my last name means death! 💀 I am a web developer from Toronto, ON. My specialty is leading agile tech teams, and building unique yet accessible e-commerce experiences.

Formality aside, I practice in digital witchcraft and general internet buffoonery.

meta.title: CV / Resume | chibi muere
meta.description: The CV and resume of M.K. Muere: a front-end tech lead and development manager based in Toronto. She specializes working in Shopify and headless stacks, with accessibility as top of mind.

heading.title: A record of the work.
heading.lede: I'm M.K. Muere, a front-end tech lead and development manager in Toronto. Shopify stores and headless websites are what I build best. I also help web teams ship semantic code with accessibility top of mind, because the internet should be easy to navigate for everyone.

entries.description: Front-end tech lead for new and retaining Shopify clients. I help teams by ensuring only the best semantic, and accessible code makes it to production.

Joined as a senior dev in 2021 & stepped into development manager in 2022. Highlights: migrating Endy.com to headless Shopify (Next, Sanity, TS), automated scheduled deployments, and introducing agile workflow to the marketing dept.
Developed and managed Shopify storefronts of large enterprise clients.

The crux of my creative and technical opinions were formed here. The people and lessons I gained in this role have influenced my career tremendously. I think of my time here fondly. (Wordpress Gutenberg, Headless Shopify)

The company of creative geniuses that took a chance on a baby developer (me). At O/B I learned taste, creative ways to solve problems, how to cook a mean tortierre, and the importance of doing our best work for deserving clients. (WordPress, WooCommerce, a11y, bespoke designs)

Six years in IT service, vendor and license management, then a stint in the digital design team. During my time there, I reviewed over 130+ contracts in the span of a year for any discrepancies; resulting in $572,200CAD of cost savings for 2014.

work.title: Things I'm proud of.
work.endy: Endy.com Site migration to headless Shopify with Next.js, Sanity CMS and TypeScript, automated scheduled deployments, and introducing an agile workflow to the web team.
work.munge: StudioMunge.com WordPress multisite, SVG animations, custom filtering, and a custom-built intranet inventory system. Won a Gold W3 Award for Architecture & Design and a Silver W3 Award for Website Features.
work.clients: Also worked with ELTE, Royal Conservatory, Canadian Cancer Society, Canada Learning Code, Interac, Another Room, Happy Fairy Art, OPFA, Forest Ontario and Salad King.

practice.title: Ways of working.
practice.leading: Leading Development manager and tech lead on both agency and product teams: agile workflows, lunch & learns, and internal guides that help teams learn best practices.
practice.building: Building Shopify and headless JAMstack with Next.js, Sanity and TypeScript, after years of WordPress, Gutenberg and custom themes.
practice.caring: Caring Semantic code with accessibility top of mind, so the internet is a better and easier-to-navigate space for all.
